Hi Sylvia — great conversation this morning. Quick recap + next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive (includes infra / security / sizing):

What we heard
- Primary goals: run inference at scale for batch/real-time, tighten 99th percentile latency to <120ms, and centralize observability.
- Regulated data flows: you need VPC+KMS and SOC2 evidence for the pilot.
- Expected pilot traffic: ~5000 requests/day with bursty peaks.

Proposed technical deep-dive (90 minutes) scope
- Architecture walkthrough (Redwood Private options and Dedicated capacity)
- Latency/cost walkthrough with sample workloads
- Security controls & audit logs (SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration)
- Open questions + next steps / mutual action plan

Because your team spans US/EU/APAC, we usually run a rotating slot cadence so critical stakeholders can join on a fair schedule. Suggested rotation model (2-week rotation, repeat):
- Slot A (US morning / EU afternoon): Tue 16:00 UTC (08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 17:00 CEST)
- Slot B (EU morning / APAC afternoon): Thu 08:00 UTC (09:00 BST / 18:00 SGT)
- Slot C (APAC evening / US late morning): Mon 00:30 UTC (09:30 AEST / 17:30 PT previous day)

Can you confirm which of these windows works for Sylvia + Amit + any infra/ops attendees? If helpful, we can do a one-off that fits your core team and then switch to the rotation for subsequent sessions.

I've attached the short discovery notes and a suggested agenda (rwd-discovery-notes.pdf). If you prefer, share a few availability blocks and I’ll wheel the calendar invites.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate with Karthik (solutions) and Soojin (CS) once you confirm.

Best,
